title: New trailer for Arkansas 2125
author: No_Piano_1857
selftext: Hey, I recently created a new trailer for my post-apocalyptic isometric game. Do you think you're any good?

comments.author: No_Piano_1857
comments.body: The game is available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4546490/Arkansas_2125/

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: How complete is the game? Is there a full campaign or story yet?

replies.author: No_Piano_1857
replies.body: There is already one ending and a second ending is planned.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: Sweet, any sort of faction system planned?

replies.author: No_Piano_1857
replies.body: I don't know yet, there is only one faction you can join

comments.author: MTOMalley
comments.body: Its comin along man, love the retro vibes on this. Funny that you could walk across the entire state in a day though?

replies.author: No_Piano_1857
replies.body: It is possible you can try to buy and pass

replies.author: No_Piano_1857
replies.body: Inspired by Fallout, it has more survival mechanics: roasting meat and sleeping. I know there are two for now, but there will be more.

comments.author: Raddrooster
comments.body: literal copy and paste fallout. vibecoding the whole thing has made the mechanics UI and literaly everything about this game a copyright nightmare. at least add some originality because AI cant do that for you
